class.name: NetwDatabaseBackend
class.brief_description: Where a [NetwDatabase] actually stores what it saves, as nine methods each returning a [NetwPromise].
class.description:
A game subclasses this to save into something of its own, and [FileSystemDatabase] is the backend this addon ships. Every method here returns a [NetwPromise] straight away and none of them may suspend. [NetwDatabase.TableRepository] is the layer above that waits on the promise, and that is where a coroutine belongs. That is what makes a backend allowed to be slow. A backend talking to a service over a socket cannot return a record on the calling frame, and a method that promised the record directly would hand its caller whatever a suspended GDScript call turns into, which is an empty record and a miss nothing reports. [codeblock] # A backend that returns on the spot. func _find_by_id(table: StringName, id: StringName) -> NetwPromise: return NetwPromise.resolved(_read(table, id))
# A backend that returns later. The caller waits on the promise. # the coroutine is deliberately not awaited here. func _find_by_id(table: StringName, id: StringName) -> NetwPromise: var settling := NetwPromise.new() _settle_later(settling, table, id) return settling
func _settle_later(settling: NetwPromise, table, id) -> void: settling.resolve(await _service.read(table, id)) [/codeblock] A method returning [enum @GlobalScope.Error] resolves its promise with that code. A rejected promise means the operation could not run. Two refusals ship from the dispatcher rather than from any backend, and both are observable: - An override that returns no promise is rejected with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_DATA], because a null would be waited on forever. - The default [method commit], the one a backend gets when it overrides no [method _commit], rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when a write it looped over has not settled. Sequencing writes that settle later is the backend's own job: the loop would have to wait, and waiting is the one thing this boundary keeps out of C++.

method.name: _commit
method.description: Override to sequence a batch of writes as one unit, each entry shaped as [method commit] takes it. The default [method commit] calls this if overridden, otherwise it plays the batch through [method upsert] one entry at a time.

method.name: _delete
method.description: Override to remove one record. [method erase] calls this.

method.name: _delete_namespace
method.description: Override to drop every table stored under [param slot]. [method delete_namespace] calls this.

method.name: _find_all
method.description: Override to return every record of [param table] whose fields match [param filter]. [method find_all] calls this.

method.name: _find_by_id
method.description: Override to return one record by its [param id]. [method find_by_id] calls this.

method.name: _initialize
method.description: Override to prepare the backend for [param slot] against [param schema], creating whatever storage the backend needs before any other verb runs. [method initialize] calls this.

method.name: _list_namespaces
method.description: Override to return every slot the backend currently holds. [method list_namespaces] calls this.

method.name: _upsert
method.description: Override to write [param data] into the record named by [param id] in [param table], creating the record if it does not exist and merging fields into it if it does. [method upsert] calls this.

method.name: _warm
method.description: Override to preload records the backend expects to need soon, as a caching hint rather than a correctness requirement. [method warm] calls this.

method.name: commit
method.description: Writes a batch of [param operations] as one unit. [codeblock lang=text] Array[Dictionary] ┖╴entry ┠╴table StringName the table the write targets ┠╴id StringName the record written ┖╴data Dictionary the fields to merge in [/codeblock] Calls [method _commit] when a backend overrides it. Otherwise plays the batch through [method upsert] in order and rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] the instant a write has not settled by the time its [NetwPromise] is checked, since a backend whose writes settle later owns its own [method _commit] to sequence them.

method.name: delete_namespace
method.description: Drops every table stored under [param slot]. Calls [method _delete_namespace].

method.name: erase
method.description: Removes the record named by [param id] from [param table]. Calls [method _delete].

method.name: find_all
method.description: Returns every record of [param table] whose fields match [param filter]. Calls [method _find_all].

method.name: find_by_id
method.description: Returns one record of [param table] by its [param id]. Calls [method _find_by_id].

method.name: in_memory
method.description: A backend that keeps every namespace in memory and writes no file, which is what a test wants when two databases would otherwise contend for one path on disk. Nothing it holds survives the process, so a game that means to keep a save uses a backend with storage behind it.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Prepares the backend for [param slot] against [param schema] before any other verb runs on it. Calls [method _initialize].

method.name: list_namespaces
method.description: Returns every slot the backend currently holds. Calls [method _list_namespaces].

method.name: upsert
method.description: Writes [param data] into the record named by [param id] in [param table], creating it if it does not exist and merging fields into it if it does. Calls [method _upsert].

method.name: warm
method.description: Preloads records the backend expects to need soon, as a caching hint rather than a correctness requirement. [codeblock lang=text] Array[Dictionary] ┖╴entry ┠╴table StringName the table to warm ┖╴request WarmRequest what to preload for it [/codeblock] Calls [method _warm].
